**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- **§ 28.1** — New York law, conflict-of-law principles excluded, CISG disapplied. This is our preferred governing law.
- **§ 28.2** — Exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, New York, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/forum objections. This is our preferred venue, and it preserves each party's right to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere to protect confidential information or IP.
- **No arbitration** — a document-wide search for "arbitration" returned nothing, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration risk (the walk-away trigger).
- **§ 28.3 escalation (per planner hint)** — the pre-filing executive meeting is mutual, capped at fifteen business days, and expressly "does not delay urgent relief or a filing needed to preserve a limitations period," so it does not impair our access to the courts or our ability to seek injunctive relief.

No competing governing-law or forum language appears elsewhere in the agreement.
